title: Effective EMF Value
description: Essential: The student must correctly calculate or state the effective EMF as 100 V.

title: Rotation Period
description: Essential: The student must correctly read or state the period from the graph as 0.04 s.

title: Angular Velocity
description: Essential: The student must correctly calculate the angular velocity as 50π rad/s.

title: Use of Peak Value
description: Important: The student must correctly identify the peak EMF from the graph as 100√2 V.

title: Apply EMF-Period Relationship
description: Important: The student must correctly relate angular velocity to period using ω = 2π/T.

title: Graph Interpretation
description: Optional: The student correctly interprets the sinusoidal graph to identify amplitude and period.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional: The student includes correct units (V, s, rad/s) with their final answers.

title: Peak vs. RMS Confusion
description: Pitfall: The student confuses peak and RMS values, e.g., stating the effective value as 100√2 V.

title: Incorrect Period Reading
description: Pitfall: The student misreads the period from the graph (e.g., 0.02 s or 0.08 s).

title: Formula Misapplication
description: Pitfall: The student uses an incorrect formula for angular velocity, e.g., ω = 1/T or ω = 2πf with wrong f.
